swaps.why: Finishes the lock on the same turn after JRS 0: "draws cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded", so 1-card libraries lose. Fumigate's "Destroy all creatures" kills Tam and our own dorks.
{W} instant: "Search your library for a planeswalker card … put that card on top". Finds JRS or Jace MA. Thrummingbird only proliferates on combat damage.
"Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand". Finds JRS, Windfall, Paradox or Mentor. The deck had one JRS and no tutor for it.
"empower Jace 5" (8th Way) and grants "[−3]: … copy that spell", which copies Windfall or Algorithm and triggers Mind Sculptor. Pia can fetch it. Tezzeret is weak with about 7 artifacts.
A third Jace whose loyalty counts "among Jaces you control" for the 25. Opponents' creatures "can't attack Jaces you control" unless they pay {2}. "+1: Draw two cards".
"Proliferate X times": adds X to every Jace (lock), every walker, and poison after Vraska −9. A cut the model also chose; Chandra's −3 kills our dorks and Tam.

{1}{W}: "Planeswalkers you control have 'No more than one creature can attack this planeswalker each combat.'" A permanent fix for walkers being attacked down, replacing a 4-mana one-shot (model cut).

Return counts only "non-Human creatures" and the party is mostly Human. Harper digs on attack: "reveal a Cleric… Rogue… Warrior… Wizard card".
Varis is a Ranger and misses the dig. Paragon "is also a Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, and Wizard": a 2-drop for any slot, and it digs six when kicked.
Acererak returns "to its owner's hand" and never holds a slot. Linvala is a Wizard: full-party lock on one permanent, "Sacrifice Linvala: hexproof or indestructible".

Warrior alpha enabler: "Flash / Double strike, vigilance, haste / Other creatures you control have haste". Ramp stays at 11 through Undermountain.

They cut the drain backup, Chandra and three tapped lands for removal, a one-sided wipe, alpha protection, a station enabler and an untap engine. Deck Score is unchanged; +1.99 is only the removal window. Plan: station to 8+ and animate (Depthshaker, or Cyberdrive into Bay into Craterclaw); backup is Arsenal + Boros Charm commander damage.

"When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped": 1-mana protection for Imotekh against destroy effects. On a Necron, the return triggers Imotekh, and Praetorian draws 2. Wishclaw hands a tutor to an opponent.

Haruspex only sees "nontoken" deaths, so it misses every Warrior. Gearhulk: "destroy another target creature". It is a 6-MV artifact creature: Szeras makes 6 {B} from it, and Ark/Technomancer can recur it.
"{5}: Permanents you control gain indestructible" protects against wipes. "Exile this card from your graveyard" also triggers Imotekh. Wraith is a 3-mana land fetch that needs combat damage.
Liliana's mandatory "mill two cards" fires for each token that enters: 4 cards per Imotekh trigger, which risks decking during loops. Edict is 2-mana instant removal.

swaps.why: The Landscape's "Cycling {R}{G}{W}" puts it outside R/G, so the deck is illegal. Overlook fetches a Mountain or Forest: two landfall triggers (Ascension, Harmonizer, Provisioner).
The Landscape's "Cycling {G}{W}{U}" is off-identity. Lair: "{X}{G}: ... becomes an X/X green Hydra creature. It's still a land". It sinks the mana Bumi untaps and attacks in the land-only combat.
The Landscape's "Cycling {B}{R}{G}" is off-identity. Turf: "{T}: Add {R}{G}", so Bumi's "untap all lands" pays 2 twice, and the bounced land is replayed for landfall.

swaps.why: Split costs "sacrifice half the lands". Nissa's Forests add extra {G}, and her +1 makes an untapped haste/vigilance land creature with 3 counters every turn, feeding Toph GE, Solid Ground and Tutelage.
Owlbear needs the defender to control "eight or more lands". Overrun: "+3/+3 and gain trample until end of turn", which also covers Bumi's land-only extra combat.
Ifrit is two loots plus {R}{R} spread over four turns. Boots: "haste and ward {1}", equip {1}, so Bumi connects the turn he lands, repeatably.
Route is a 4-MV duplicate of the deck's 2-MV ramp. Silkguard: "modified creatures you control gain hexproof". Every earthbended land is modified, and so is Bumi if X >= 1 targets him.
A 5-MV death trigger with no setup in this deck. Augmenter: "Flash / Commander creatures you control get +2/+2. / Commanders you control have hexproof." Bumi is the single point of failure.

review.verdict: The sleeved deck is illegal: 3 Landscapes are outside R/G, and fixing them is mandatory. 8 free swaps take the objective from -14.69 to 37.37 and Deck Score from 19 to 57.2. About +44 of that is the 100-card restoration. Nissa and Overrun are judgment calls; the model cannot see earthbend. Plan holds: Bumi connects, untaps lands, land-only combat, Toph double strike.
risks: Gruul Turf (1 copy) and Riveteers Overlook are also in the pending Gilanra stompy draft. A parallel Gilanra review may pick Overrun, Nissa, Silkguard or Boots.

Model blind spots: the Nissa and Overrun deltas are 0. Augmenter's +7.86 (measured against the Kami variant) is mostly the win component's close-turn step, not a precise value.
The climb's 78.41 comes from cutting ramp 21 -> 10 to fit the role window plus filler removal bodies. Rejected as anti-plan.
The gate SKIPPED ownership. All 8 adds were checked by hand: in collection.txt, in no deck file, not in the ban list.
Moraug and The Legend of Kyoshi were avoided: tazri-final and the Gilanra draft hold them.

Win line 1's 'P(kill <= T6) .655' is the draft's sim, not the sleeved deck's.

Merits hold (flash, Bumi hexproof). Reported Δ +7.86 is wrong: the single-swap Δ is +0.01 (model blind). The 'no setup' claim is also false, since earthbended land deaths trigger Part in Friendship.

Measured alone it is +0.01, so REVIEW.md needs that number corrected. All oracle quotes check out. Two claims are overstated: Tectonic Split 'anti-plan' and Part in Friendship 'no setup'. All 8 adds are owned, in no deck file and not banned. final.txt has 100 cards, is singleton and stays inside R/G. There are no locks (no .md guide). CPU capped at 50%.

review.verdict: No swaps; null result. All four climb swaps (+9.4 total) came from the role windows. They cut the Altar lock, Dark Ritual and Culling Ritual (both operator decisions) and Zulaport. Arnyn stays OUT: ≈0 for the model in every slot. The deck's anthems (Liege, Mikaeus, Baloth, Blech) switch off its P/T ≤1 clause, and it drains one opponent. Skorpekh→Arnyn scored −8.56 (win step). Fix the guide's 12 errors.
risks: The list sits on the win component's T8/T9 close-turn edge. Cutting any 3-power attacker or draw piece reads −8 to −10, so slot deltas are bimodal.
The model is blind to drains, sacrifice outlets, Omnipresence free casting and Insidious Roots token mana. Most of the plan is judgment, not score.
Golgari Rot Farm is still an unconfirmed precon-list registration.
The climb ran 2 passes at 100 games and did not converge. Its +0.26 for Zulaport -> Conduit Pylons is within noise.
guideErrors: §1 line 3, §2 rows 4 and 6: 'every token dies twice' with Mikaeus undying is wrong. Tokens cease to exist in the graveyard (CR 111.7/704.5d), so only nontoken non-Humans return. The Blech counter caveat is moot for tokens.

§10 'Never Saw on Beledros (command zone = did not die)' is wrong. The commander dies and only then moves to the command zone (CR 903.9a). Saw in Half on your own Beledros gives two 2/2 flying copies, each with its own upkeep Pest and once-per-turn pay-10 untap.
§2 Greaves caveat: Vesuva and Thespian's Stage only copy lands and never target Beledros. Shroud actually blocks your own Revitalizing Repast and Saw in Half on him.
§2 'nothing else in the list protects him' is false. Imp's Mischief, Veil of Summer, Revitalizing Repast (indestructible) and Saw in Half all protect him. The §6 protection count also misses Repast.

§2 'Token deaths draw through Moldervine, Liliana and Village Rites only' is wrong. Morbid Opportunist ('one or more other creatures die') counts tokens once each turn, including opponents' turns. Priest, Braids and Deadly Dispute also draw.
§1 table row 2 lists Veinwitch Coven as a rebuy piece, but it is no longer in the 99.
§7 'Mikaeus returns' is wrong. He grants undying only to 'Other non-Human creatures'.
§8 misplay 2: Thespian's Stage copying Rot Farm does not enter the battlefield, so nothing bounces and it taps for {B}{G}. The real trap is Vesuva copying Rot Farm.
§5 mulligan odds are one draw short with 34 lands instead of 35. Third land by T3 is about 62% on the play and 77% on the draw, not 37% and 60%.
§5 mulligan table and bottoming order still name Deadly Tempest and Alhammarret's Archive, which are not in the 99.

§2 row 9: Turn Stones is a {B}{G} sorcery copy, so 3 Pests per round, not per turn. §2 row 13: in a 4-pod only 3 of the round's 4 Pests can tap for mana on your turn (your own upkeep Pest is summoning-sick), and Victimize is not in the list.
§10 Arnyn row ignores the anthems (Creakwood Liege makes Pests 3/3, plus Mikaeus, Baloth and Blech), which switch off the P/T ≤1 clause.

review.commander: Gilanra, Caller of Wirewood + Alena, Kessig Trapper
review.modelPath: verify-2026-10-08/gilanra-stompy/final.txt (the pending draft stands in for the model: the lab cannot score partners, 46 cards read as missing, so score.ts and the swap lab were not run)

swaps.why: The operator asked for it. Avatar's "All creatures have double strike" helps opponents too. Hexhaven: "Whenever this creature is dealt damage, you may search ... land cards". Warstorm, Terror, Burning Sun's Avatar, Drakuseth and Myojin can target it; each fetched land makes a Baloths token.
Fling makes you "sacrifice a creature". Frog says "{T}: Add one mana of any color", so Gilanra comes down on T2. Sim: keep-7 goes up.
Roxanne costs 5 and her Meteorite enters tapped. Caryatid costs 2 and says "add two mana of any one color" with power 4+. 31 creatures have power 5+.
Slinza's "Beast spells cost {2} less" helps only a few cards. Florahedron is a 2-MV "{T}: Add {G}" dork or a Tangled Vale land when the hand needs one.
Planar Engineering costs 4 and makes you "Sacrifice two lands". Selvala: "{G},{T}: Add X mana ... greatest power". Sim: +.47 more 6+ casts than Simulacrum Shaper in this slot.
Recluse is a 0/3 whose cascade mostly hits ramp. Annex is an FRA land: "{T}: Add {R} or {G}". It is land #37.

Bane says "destroy all artifacts and enchantments", which kills our own Sol Ring, Signet, Talisman, Vortex, Warstorm and Gearhulks. Thicket is a "Mountain Forest" with cycling and is land #38. Sim: this beats cutting Diamond City on every metric.

Ruric deals 6 to whoever "casts a noncreature spell", including us, and we cast 11. Echoes is an FRA instant: "6 damage to target creature or planeswalker". It is the deck's only instant-speed removal.

review.verdict: Make the 8 swaps: the lab is blind to partners, so they are justified by oracle text and the deck's goldfish sim (10k games). Against the sleeved list: keep-7 .60→.69, 4th land on T4 .84→.86, 6+ casts by T8 8.87→9.38, spells cast 14.8→16.4, screwed .028→.016. Adds Hexhaven and 3 FRA cards, all from the free pool. The full pending draft is still stronger on consistency; these 8 are stage 1.
risks: Cutting Bane of Progress leaves the deck with no artifact/enchantment answer. Cleanup Crew (free) for Hoard-Smelter Dragon is the next swap.
Hexhaven costs GGGG, and the lands it fetches enter tapped. Selvala's draw is symmetric: "its controller may draw".
The sim's clock by T7 is flat (.471 to .468). It models Avatar's double strike against no blockers but not Hexhaven's lands or Violent Echoes, so treat it as a lower bound.

The pending draft (gilanra-stompy/final.txt) uses Beast Within and Fabled Passage. Both are banned by name (Beledros/Inspirit), though one spare copy of each exists by count. Rule on this before sleeving the draft.
Konstrari Annex enters tapped unless Domri or Garruk is on the battlefield.
No swap-lab or score.ts numbers exist (partners read as missing); every number is the deck's own goldfish sim, seed 7.
guideErrors: The guide describes the unsleeved draft (gilanra-stompy/final.txt), not the sleeved list. The sleeved deck has no guide of its own.
§2 row 1 says "41 spells of MV 6+ in the 98". The draft has 37, because the 10-08 FRA patches replaced 6+ drops with cheaper cards.
§2 row 11 says "36 of 39 creatures are 5+ power". The draft has 48 creatures, 32 of them with power 5 or more.
§2 row 9 says "Block with it; every Moraug landfall from it is another combat". Moraug's trigger requires "if it's your main phase", so lands fetched while blocking add no combat.
§8 lists Earthshaker Dreadmaw as a maybeboard option, but it is already in the main deck.
§3/§7 still count Fabled Passage and Beast Within as free. Both are now in Beledros/Inspirit and in the ban file.

verdicts.reason: Operator's request. Avatar's double strike and forced attacks hit both sides. All 7 Hexhaven enablers are confirmed in the oracle text. Lab -0.18 is blind noise.
Fling costs a card. A 2-drop any-colour dork helps keep-7. The review's 'Gilanra on T2' claim is false: Frog taps on T3. The real gain is Alena on T4.
A 5-MV maker of tapped rocks becomes a 2-MV dork that taps for 2 with power 4+. Oracle quotes are correct. Lab +2.00 is the ramp window.

The review misquotes Slinza: it leaves out her repeatable fight when a 4+ power creature enters. That cuts removal in a removal-thin batch. Put Florahedron in for Havoc Eater, Woodwurm or Sledge-Captain instead.
X mana from 5-8 power bodies far beats Planar's net +2 lands. Risks: fragile, and her draw is symmetric. Lab +3.95 (window plus advantage).
37th land in a 6-drop deck. Recluse's cascade is a coin-flip. Annex enters tapped unless we control a planeswalker (Domri/Garruk); quoted correctly.
Leaves zero enchantment answers; the review admits the gap. Cleanup Crew is owned, free, 6 MV and kills an artifact or enchantment: do Bane -> Cleanup Crew, Thicket for a filler.
Ruric punishes our own noncreature spells (12 in the sleeved list, not 11) and must attack. Echoes is instant 6-damage removal, the only instant once Fling leaves.
